description.value: Chasters Restaurant is the award-winning fine dining venue at Bonniebrook Lodge, the Sunshine Coast's oldest oceanfront heritage lodge in Gibsons, with nearly a century of history. The seasonal menu leans heavily on local and organic Sunshine Coast ingredients, offering à la carte and table d'hôte options spanning fresh seafood, rack of lamb, duck breast, and vegetarian mains in a smart casual room overlooking Georgia Strait. For touring cyclists riding the Ocean Beach Esplanade, it represents one of the most historically significant and scenically situated sit-down meal stops on the coast.
